ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: How many stages of the butterfly life cycle are there?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The picture is a schematic diagram of the butterfly life cycle connected into a circle with arrows. Four different morphological nodes can be seen: at the bottom there is an egg, on the left there is a caterpillar/larva, at the top there is a pupa/chrysalis hanging on a branch, and on the right there is an adult butterfly. Reasoning: The question asks how many stages the butterfly life cycle has, rather than asking to list the names of the stages. Counting each different morphological node in the picture as one stage, there are four stages in total: egg, larva, pupa, adult, so the answer is 4.
